films.title: Godzilla Minus Zero
films.plot: War reduced Japan to zero, and Godzilla plunged it into minus. Two years have passed since then, and the country has faced agonizing struggles to achieve recovery and finally reclaim its daily life. Just as humanity managed to cling to a hard-won peace, a new threat strikes, crushing hope in an instant. There is no third time. Everything ends here.

films.title: Ramayana: Rise of a Legend
films.plot: An ancient epic follows a young prince and princess whose marriage and subsequent exile mark the beginning of a legendary journey. Their story of love, duty and destiny sets the stage for greater challenges ahead.

films.title: Other Mommy
films.plot: Young Bela forms a relationship with a sinister entity in her home that looks uncannily like her own mother, drawing her into a terrifying and increasingly dark world.

films.title: La Bola Negra
films.plot: The intertwined lives of three men in three different eras, three lives intimately linked by sexuality and desire, pain, and legacy.

films.title: Wildwood
films.plot: Prue and her classmate Curtis are drawn into a magical forest filled with enchanted creatures, loyal allies, and formidable adversaries as they embark on a desperate quest to rescue Prue's abducted baby brother from a murder of crows led by a mysterious woman named Alexandra.

films.title: Clayface
films.plot: Matt Hagen's meteoric rise from Gotham street kid to Hollywood leading man is tragically cut short when a local crime boss's actions leave him horribly disfigured. Abandoned by his team and with nothing left, Matt seeks out a cutting edge treatment that miraculously returns him to his former self… but also unexpectedly affects his grip on reality, spiraling him down a destructive path of all-consuming revenge.

films.title: Primetime
films.plot: In 2006, To Catch a Predator host Chris Hansen sets out to make television history. When a high stakes operation goes fatally wrong, his veneered dream of fame curdles into a nightmare of performative justice.

films.title: Wild Horse Nine
films.plot: Shortly before the 1973 Chilean coup, CIA agents Chris and Lee are dispatched from Santiago to Easter Island by their bureau chief, MJ. Amongst the Island's iconic statues, and as the longtime partners wrestle with their dark pasts and present conspiracies, Chris's newfound bond with a pair of rebellious students threatens to send everyone’s trip to this remote paradise sideways.

films.title: Forgotten Island
films.plot: While celebrating their last night together, high school graduates and best friends Jo and Raissa stumble upon a mysterious portal that transports them to the fantastical island of Nakali. When they discover that the memories of their entire friendship are the price for returning home, Jo and Raissa must race to find a way to leave the island before they forget each other forever.

films.title: Street Fighter
films.plot: In 1993, estranged Street Fighters Ryu and Ken Masters are thrown back into combat when the mysterious Chun-Li recruits them for the next World Warrior Tournament: a brutal clash of fists, fate, and fury. But behind this battle royale lies a deadly conspiracy that forces them to face off against each other and the demons of their past. And if they don't, it's GAME OVER!

films.title: Possible Love
films.plot: A laid-off worker and his wife cross paths with a documentary filmmaker and her spouse and confront their hidden desires.

films.title: Ebenezer
films.plot: An elderly miser embarks on a supernatural journey after visits from the ghost of his former business partner and the Spirits of Christmas Past, Present, and Yet to Come force him to confront his past and fight for a second chance at happiness.

films.title: Wicker
films.plot: On the outskirts of a village by the sea, lives a Fisherwoman; smelly, single and perpetually ridiculed. One day, fed up with her stuffy, small-minded neighbours, she commissions herself a husband to be made from wicker. In an otherwise conservative town, this unconventional romance sparks outrage, jealousy and chaos.

films.title: Scene
films.plot: Inbaraj, a police officer, is forced to come back from retirement when a new case resembles one he closed years ago. This time, he must solve it with a chaotic and troublesome team. As they struggle to work together and deal with the twists and turns of the case, the investigation takes them on a chaotic and unpredictable ride.

films.title: The Hunger Games: Sunrise on the Reaping
films.plot: Return to the world of Panem 24 years before the events of The Hunger Games, starting on the morning of the reaping of the 50th Hunger Games, also known as the Second Quarter Quell.

films.title: Whalefall
films.plot: Following the death of his father, Jay Gardiner goes diving off the central Coast of California in search of his remains, but is swallowed by a massive sperm whale. While trapped inside its belly with only one hour of oxygen left, Jay comes to realize that the hard-earned lessons his father imparted may be the key to his escape.

films.title: Fjord
films.plot: When a devout Romanian family resettles in a small Norwegian town, they become the subject of public scandal when their daughter shows up to school with unexplained bruises. As allegations of abuse emerge, they are swept up in an investigation that blurs the line between concern and prejudice.

films.title: Ali G: Who Iz I?
films.plot: After twenty years spent "chillin', tokin' and bonin'", Ali G is shocked to discover that his long-term girlfriend, Julie, is 8 months pregnant. Faced with an extra mouth to feed, he gets off his batty and heads to America to reclaim his former glory… but soon encounters adversaries who will ultimately threaten his and his child's very existence.

films.title: How to Rob a Bank
films.plot: A crew of social media-savvy bank robbers broadcasts their daring heists, unaware that their growing viral fame has put them in the crosshairs of a veteran FBI agent and a brilliant software engineer. Despite the unlikely duo closing in, the crime ring pushes past their limits, putting everything on the line for their most ambitious heist yet.

films.title: Jailer 2
films.plot: When a dangerous syndicate threatens his family, retired jailer Tiger Muthuvel Pandian goes undercover as a driver to battle enemies from the shadows.

films.title: The Social Reckoning
films.plot: Frances Haugen, a young Facebook engineer, enlists the help of Jeff Horwitz, a Wall Street Journal reporter, to go on a dangerous journey that ends up blowing the whistle on the social network's most guarded secrets.

films.title: Klara and the Sun
films.plot: When Klara, an Artificial Friend who wants nothing more than to find the perfect home, meets Josie, each immediately senses a kindred spirit in the other. Josie has a fraught relationship with her mother and they've suffered great loss, but Klara's innocent wonder and unwavering loyalty begin to heal the family and bring light to Josie's complicated world.

films.title: The Restoration at Grayson Manor
films.plot: The foundations of Grayson Manor are shaken when an accident leaves Boyd Grayson handless and his mother invests in radical new technology to help him.

films.title: The Uprising
films.plot: As war and plague devastate 14th-century England, a humble peasant ignites a rebellion, uniting an army of commoners to defy the King’s might in a desperate fight for justice and survival.

films.title: Fatherland
films.plot: In 1949, German writer Thomas Mann and his daughter Erika embark on a road trip across a Germany in ruins, from US-dominated Frankfurt to Soviet-controlled Weimar.

films.title: I Play Rocky
films.plot: The electrifying true story about an unknown actor with an unshakable belief that he wasn't just meant to write Rocky—he was meant to be Rocky Balboa. Told "no" at every turn, Sylvester Stallone bets everything on himself, holding the line on playing the lead against seemingly impossible odds.

films.title: Monster Mia
films.plot: 12-year-old Mia and her scruffy pet rat Quentin are sent to the mysterious Rotwood Academy after one too many problems at school. The new school gives her the creeps, and Mia needs to figure a way out before the students realize she isn't a monster like them! But the vice principal Van Vlad hosts a particular dislike for humans, and Mia is scared he has seen through her act...

films.title: Kung Fu Soccer
films.plot: Dismissed as underdogs before they even step onto the pitch, the Emei Women's Football Team enters the prestigious Supreme Invincible Cup determined to prove everyone wrong. Led by captain Shuangshuang, star striker Yulong, and mentor Xu Feng, the team combines martial arts mastery with football skill in a thrilling quest for victory. Against mounting challenges and impossible odds, they fight to make their mark and chase their championship dream.

films.title: NAZA
films.plot: Filmed at night from Tel Aviv rooftops, this investigative documentary examines the civilian casualties of Israel's military operations in Gaza and the systems behind targeted killings of Palestinians.

films.title: Ranabaali
films.plot: Set in 19th-century British India, a fierce leader rises from a drought-stricken land to fight colonial oppression and atrocities.

films.title: The Devils
films.plot: In 1634 France, charismatic Father Urbain Grandier becomes the target of sexually depraved Sister Jeanne's accusations of witchcraft, which corrupt officials of church and state are all too happy to exploit.​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​

films.title: Premada Oorali
films.plot: Premada Oorali is a heartfelt love story set in picturesque villages in the 2020s. The film intertwines romance and family drama, exploring the relationships between a father and son, as well as a boy and girl, as they navigate through intriguing, yet relatable, relationship challenges.

films.title: Nightborn
films.plot: In Finnish forest, Saga and her husband Jon embark on a new chapter as parents. But Saga's joy is overshadowed by a chilling suspicion about their newborn, unbeknownst to Jon, causing a rift as she alone grapples with the disturbing truth.

films.title: Disco
films.plot: An ordinary man undergoes a transformation as he enters the dark and dangerous world of the underworld.

films.title: Arrietty
films.plot: 14-year-old Arrietty and the rest of the Clock family live in peaceful anonymity as they make their own home from items "borrowed" from the house's human inhabitants. However, life changes for the Clocks when a human boy discovers Arrietty.
films.original_title: 借りぐらしのアリエッティ

films.title: Raise the Red Lantern
films.plot: In 1920s China, 19-year-old Songlian becomes a concubine of a powerful lord and is forced to compete with his three wives for the privileges gained.

films.title: DNK
films.plot: A young man with a compulsive stealing habit brings trouble upon his family, who must deal with the consequences of his actions.

films.title: The Mosquito Bowl
films.plot: In the aftermath of Pearl Harbor, four college football stars enlist in the US Marines, discovering the strength of brotherhood and the cost of war.

films.title: Everest: The Other Side
films.plot: An intimate portrait of two people bound by love, ambition, and the pursuit of the impossible. Elite ski mountaineers Jim Morrison and Hilaree Nelson fell deeply in love while reaching the pinnacle of their sport. Their drive sharpened into a shared dream: to climb and ski the direct North Face of Mount Everest—the most difficult and dangerous climb on the mountain and the most coveted ski line on Earth—something only a handful have ever achieved, and no one has successfully skied down.

films.title: I Love Boosters
films.plot: A group of shoplifters take aim at a cutthroat fashion maven by stealing from her stores and reselling them at a lower price — what they call 'fashion-forward philanthropy'.

films.title: George Michael: The Faith Tour
films.plot: A stunning delve into George Michael's 1988 Faith Tour, as shot live at the famous Palais Omnisports de Paris-Bercy. This exclusive footage, assembled from a 14-camera shoot captured on 35mm over two nights (30–31 May 1988), features the 24-year-old pop star at the height of his powers.

films.title: Ghosts: The Possession of Button House
films.plot: It's a matter of life and death for Alison, Mike, Mia and the Ghosts.

films.title: Always Yours, Never Mine
films.plot: Across thirty years, several almosts, and timing that is never quite right, two people keep crossing paths – always on the verge of being together, but never quite making it.

films.title: Nayyi Navelli
films.plot: A new bride's arrival turns a turbulent household in Meerut into a picture of domestic harmony, until her brother-in-law grows convinced that his seemingly perfect sister-in-law is secretly a witch.

films.title: It's My Time
films.plot: At the age of seventy, a fiercely non-conformist grandmother partners with a lethargic, underachieving young prodigy to navigate the highly competitive and eccentric subculture of speedcubing, defying familial skepticism and generational expectations.

films.title: Whispers in the Woods
films.plot: In the heart of the tranquil Vosges forests, where lynxes, bears and deer roam freely, Vincent Munier accompanies his father on his expeditions. He not only seeks to capture the visual wonders of this forest kingdom, but also aims to make its sounds audible. Every whisper of the forest is a reminder of the knowledge of nature that his father once imbued in him – knowledge that Vincent now passes on to his own son. Vincent Munier combines breathtaking footage of nature and its sounds to create a fairytale-like cinematic experience that slows time down.

films.title: Gentle Monster
films.plot: After relocating with her family to the countryside, a renowned pianist uncovers a life-shattering truth that forces her to confront the complexities of love, trust, and deception.

films.title: Aadarsha Kutumbam House No: 47 - AK47
films.plot: A tight-knit family faces an unexpected crisis that threatens their bond, forcing them to re-evaluate their values and fight to stay united.

films.title: Case 137
films.plot: When Internal Affairs officer Stéphanie investigates a young man severely injured during a chaotic Paris demonstration and finds no police misconduct, the routine case hits close to home upon her discovering the victim is from her native town.

films.title: Go for Broke 2
films.plot: After their children are brutalised, Sheila and her brother Su Cheng uncover a sinister conspiracy through perilous investigations. Battling for justice, they expose the corrupt network while finding redemption in their vengeful quest.

films.title: Merry Christmas Aubrey Flint
films.plot: An amateur production of A Christmas Carol at a retirement home is reluctantly directed by reclusive man on community service.

films.title: Always Lalisa
films.plot: Documentary following global superstar LISA during a transformative year away from BLACKPINK, the K-pop phenomenon that made her one of the world's most recognizable performers. Documenting a year of risk, reinvention, and self-discovery as LISA begins to define her next chapter.

films.title: The Yellow Tie
films.plot: The extraordinary life of Sergiu Celibidache, from his childhood in Romania to his exile in pursuit of a career in music, his struggle for survival in wartime Germany and his rise, fall and rise again, in an unimaginable life journey.

films.title: Onwards and Sideways
films.plot: Tony Evans is the deputy head of a local primary school. Emma Dretzin is a pianist, composer and single mother of two daughters. Neither knows the other until a startling encounter changes the course of their lives: on the same morning, they are both confronted with a diagnosis of Parkinson’s.

films.title: Comédie-Française
films.plot: At the Comédie-Française, there is one golden rule: the play is never canceled. Unfortunately for Nina, everything else is—just three hours before the premiere of her first staging. An actor is stuck on a train, tensions explode, equipment breaks down, egos clash, and panic sets in. With no way out and time slipping away, Nina must hold the show together at all costs. Will she make it until the curtain rises?

films.title: Traces of Justice
films.plot: The film follows criminal police officer Cui Xun over half a century of investigative work. Alongside his colleagues, he solved numerous major cases while staying true to his original aspiration of 'serving the people.' This legendary detective not only witnessed the evolution of China's public security system but also stood as a living testament to the rise of New China.

films.title: Prima Facie
films.plot: Tessa is a brilliant British defence barrister dominating London’s ruthless courtrooms. Fierce, witty, and self-made, she defends men accused of sexual assault — until she is assaulted herself by a colleague from a powerful legal dynasty.  Suddenly, the system she trusted turns against her. As she faces the same tactics she once used in court, Tessa’s faith in justice unravels. Once in control, now exposed and disbelieved, she must fight to reclaim her voice and sense of self.

films.title: Winter of the Crow
films.plot: Warsaw, 1981. Martial law shuts down the country, turning it into a prison overnight. Taxis are replaced by tanks, citizens are treated like criminals, and visiting British Professor Joan Andrews finds herself trapped. After witnessing the murder of a young student by the secret police, Joan herself becomes the target.

films.title: The Influencer Project
films.plot: Influencer Chiara King travels to Copenhagen with a documentary crew promising an unfiltered look behind the glamorous business of online fame. But as the cameras and her devoted fans follow her every move, someone else is watching too. When an obsessive stalker begins closing in, the documentary mutates into something far more terrifying, blurring the line between content and evidence, follower and predator, fact and fiction.

films.title: The Irregular at Magic High School THE MOVIE - Yotsuba Succession Arc -
films.plot: The invitation has arrived. It's time for the New Year's Reception at the Yotsuba family residence. This year, Miyuki and other candidates will gather there to decide who will be the next leader of their powerful clan. If chosen as successor, she would never again have to see her brother live as an outcast. At the same time, such a position would surely entail a political marriage, leaving her mind in complete turmoil. To complicate matters, the current head of the family sows doubt with a shocking statement. When the new year arrives, their relationship may change forever...
films.original_title: 魔法科高校の劣等生 四葉継承編

films.title: The Disciple: A Wu-Tang Fable
films.plot: This documentary recounts Cilvaringz's unlikely rise from fan to Wu-Tang Clan fame — and how the infamous "Once Upon a Time in Shaolin" album came to be.

films.title: Animol
films.plot: Behind the walls of a young offender institution, Troy is thrust into a brutal world of gangs, loyalty and violence from the moment he arrives. When an unspoken bond develops with a fellow inmate, it becomes a dangerous vulnerability for them.

films.title: The Jillon
films.plot: From the mind of Harry Hill, starring Richard Ayoade, Richard Syms and Flip Webster comes a gloriously absurd dark comedy about an 86-year-old woman whose desperate wish to become a mother is granted, with consequences nobody could have imagined.

films.title: ENE Repeat
films.plot: A close-knit group of friends embark on another unforgettable journey, where old memories, new adventures, and unexpected twists test their friendship.

films.title: The Lost Children of Tuam
films.plot: When amateur historian Catherine Corless begins examining records from a former Mother and Baby Home in Tuam, Co. Galway, she stumbles upon evidence pointing towards a deeply troubling past. Refusing to let the questions go, she embarks on a painstaking investigation, putting her in conflict with the Church, State, and local town. As official resistance mounts, and unsettling discoveries emerge, her determination challenges powerful institutions, exposing a hidden chapter of Ireland's past that many would rather keep hidden.

films.title: Bouma
films.plot: A struggling singer returns to an isolated, secret-shrouded estate tied to her own forgotten past. Simultaneously, a police investigation into a series of missing women intersects with the estate, blurring past memories and active crime.

films.title: Avedon
films.plot: Richard Avedon's photographs didn't just reflect culture, they shaped it, and continue to do so. The feature documentary AVEDON traces the life and legacy of an artist who used fashion, portraiture, and commercial photography to explore identity, power, fear and beauty. With unprecedented access to Avedon's archive, including never before seen photos, behind the scenes recordings, and interviews with those who knew him best, AVEDON is a visually stunning examination of the mind of an artist who shaped our collective image of the 20th century.

films.title: Nuisance Bear
films.plot: A polar bear is forced to navigate a human world of tourists, wildlife officers, and hunters as its ancient migration collides with modern life. When a sacred predator is branded a nuisance, it becomes unclear who truly belongs in this shared landscape.

films.title: The Doll
films.plot: Wealthy merchant Stanislaw Wokulski falls tragically in love with beautiful yet vain Izabela Lecka. His unfulfilled love leads to many foolish decisions sealing his fate.

films.title: Fallen Angels by Noël Coward
films.plot: Two upper-class wives, their husbands away for the day, share a few toasts to their pre-marital dalliances—with the same man, who just may be en route from France to visit. Old rivalries and past scandals bubble to the surface in this intoxicating romp from one of theatre’s comedy masters.

films.title: Festive Fun with Peppa
films.plot: Join Peppa Pig and her family as they celebrate baby Evie’s first Christmas. This festive cinema experience brings together seven classic festive-themed Peppa Pig episodes, new interstitial content, and four brand-new songs with music videos. From snowy adventures and festive plays to decorating the Christmas tree, Peppa and her family share treasured Christmas memories in this special big-screen experience.

films.title: By Design
films.plot: A woman swaps bodies with a chair, and everyone likes her better as a chair.

films.title: Prahaar: The Untold Story of Ujjwal Nikam
films.plot: Public prosecutor Ujjwal Nikam takes on one of the most high-profile criminal cases in India’s history, leading the prosecution in the trial of Ajmal Kasab following the 26/11 Mumbai terror attacks. As he battles to uncover the truth and secure justice, Nikam must confront the immense personal and professional burden of a case that will define his legacy.
films.original_title: प्रहार: दी अनटोल्ड स्टोरी ऑफ़ उज्ज्वल निकम

films.plot: Set in a medical college in a dread-stricken village, the film confronts the science behind superstitions, the superstitions in science, and an anomaly that neither can explain.

films.title: Push The Machine
films.plot: A young stuntman embarks on the most perilous, and illegal, project of his life. With the police hot on his trail, and an arduous mission to reach the takeoff, the jump itself is only half the challenge.

films.title: Bad Day at the Office
films.plot: A man with amnesia wakes up in a wrecked hotel room next to a corpse, triggering a dangerous conspiracy. He and a maid try to recover his memories and evade the police to uncover the mystery and survive those pursuing them.

films.title: A Fox Under a Pink Moon
films.plot: At just 16, Soraya is already creating stunning drawings and sculptures that are as beautiful as they are dark. This strong-willed Afghan sculptor and illustrator has been trying for five years to escape Iran and join her mother in Austria.

films.title: Titans
films.plot: Small-time gangster Antony Yakuza teams up with young programmer Anwar to pull off a major heist, with mysterious driver Rejimon joining them. But Rejimon is not who he seems, and their simple crime soon turns into a strange, unpredictable journey where reality itself begins to blur.

films.title: 1 in 2
films.plot: Nearly one in two of us will be diagnosed with cancer at some point in our lives. David Nicholas Wilkinson is one of them, twice over. 1 in 2 follows Wilkinson through his own treatment, where he discovers a steep rise in bowel cancer among people far too young to be screened for it, and far too young, it seems, to be believed.

films.title: Batulo Jun
films.plot: Abhiman, freshly graduated and recruited for a government job, returns to his village. Seeing his villagers struggling with basic literacy, he chooses to stay and contribute, eventually falling in love with Jun— unaware that fate will test their relationship.

films.title: Royal Opera House: Carmen
films.plot: Carmen declares that any man she loves should beware. However, even she is unprepared for what will happen when she decides to seduce Don José, an army corporal who initially appears uninterested in her charms. Don José soon abandons his sweetheart Micaëla and his army job for Carmen, and joins her and her smuggler friends in the mountains. But Carmen quickly wearies of Don José's possessiveness. When she turns her attentions to the dashing toreador Escamillo, Don José's jealousy erupts into violence.

films.title: Bloodline
films.plot: An ancient curse with roots in Egypt resurfaces in a mysterious Istanbul mansion. Summoned to the estate by his dying grandfather, Can and his friends are soon forced to confront the mansion's dark secrets and a supernatural threat.

films.title: All Rivers Spill Their Stories to the Sea
films.plot: On England’s North East coast, where rivers, heavy industry and the sea have shaped lives for generations, fisherman Stan Rennie is watching the world he knows disappear. His family have worked these waters for generations. Then, almost overnight, thousands of dead crabs and lobsters wash ashore, and a community already living with uncertainty is pushed into crisis. Teesside filmmaker Jeanie Finlay brings warmth, wit and deep local feeling to this David-and-Goliath story of environmental damage, official evasions and working-class resilience. At its centre is Stan: funny, stubborn, vulnerable and increasingly determined to be heard.

films.title: Manipulation
films.plot: Across Europe and beyond, a powerful elite society operates in plain sight while exerting unseen control. What appears to be influence is, in fact, a sophisticated system of manipulation embedded within both political structures and the Church itself. As the layers are peeled back, the thriller reveals an omnipresent threat — adaptive, relentless, and far more powerful than initially believed — challenging the very notion of free will and authority in the modern world.

films.title: TOMORROW X TOGETHER WORLD TOUR 'ACT : TOMORROW'
films.plot: Like shining stars, TOMORROW X TOGETHER’s fourth world tour 'ACT : TOMORROW' unfolds as a dazzling journey toward the tomorrow they promised together. From its beautiful storytelling to the stunning production and powerful live performances that captivated MOA around the world, experience the immersive energy of TOMORROW X TOGETHER’s spectacular world tour on the big screen!

films.title: Codes
films.plot: Following a major attack on British soil, a politician discovers the only way of saving his country is by killing the man in front of him.

films.title: DDT XX Century
films.plot: From Malevich’s “Black Square” to “Black Dog of St. Petersburg” — this is how DDT and filmmaker Sergei Kuznetsov defines the boundaries of the short 20th century. All the characters in the film are the heroes of DDT’s songs. Each episode is one track and one unique artistic method. The live‑action episodes alternate with chronicles, fragments of documentary films — both classic and little‑known — as well as with animation.

films.title: Our Share of Sand
films.plot: After years apart, 12 year-old Maya returns to India with her mother to reunite with her father - a sandmining business man. Immersed in a world where labour, legacy and extraction collide, she forms a fragile bond with Kiran, a young worker. After a tragic event, a police investigation turns Maya into a key witness, with her father relying on her to absolve him. Torn between loyalty and a growing unease she cannot name, Maya begins searching for the truth. As her mother quietly unravels, Maya uncovers a pattern of silence, exploitation and repeated harm forcing her to confront her father's deception and the family's complicity she must choose to break.

films.title: Gupi and the King Who Doesn't Smile
films.plot: Gupi and her friends enter an abandoned apartment in their building to deliver a cake. By passing through a closet in one of the rooms, they find themselves in a dark, unhappy, and otherworldly dimension. This place is home to the palace of the King Who Does Not Smile, whose sorrow has spread across the entire realm. Realizing that the inhabitants of this dimension have lost their joy because the King never smiles, Gupi begins trying various methods to restore happiness to the kingdom.

films.title: Beyond
films.plot: Follows people living with and beyond cancer as they discover strength, connection, and a new sense of possibility through climbing. Set between indoor walls and wild mountain rock, it is a powerful story about recovery becoming adventure.

films.title: Kiri and Lou Go Raaa!
films.plot: The movie follows Lou, a gentle purple creature with an embarrassingly stretchy trunk, as he rescues Kiri, an ungrateful little dinosaur, from a flood — sweeping the pair into the greatest adventure in prehistory. Along the way, they discover that you can find friendship in the wildest places.

films.title: Rubbers
films.plot: A neurodivergent woman who struggles to form relationships explores her private passion for stationery to unlock her explosive fantasy world. A comedy fantasy…with a dark twist, where the pen is mightier than the sword.

films.title: Chha Maya Chhapakkai 2
films.plot: An aging political comrade leaves his career behind for marriage, only to find himself trapped in a chaotic, comical bind between two women and the bitter grudges of opposing political families.

films.title: A Rose for Iris
films.plot: On the shores of England, a teenage girl witnesses her father's cruelty toward a migrant who has just arrived by small boat, forcing her to confront the complexities of both her father and the world around her.

films.title: Amazing Grace
films.plot: On the brink of suicide, a deeply isolated man forms an unexpected bond with a crisis helpline volunteer who helps him confront the childhood abuse, addiction, and shame he has spent a lifetime trying to survive.

films.title: Black Cab
films.plot: Harry, a third-generation cab driver in London, struggles to find his place and purpose in a fast-changing world.

films.title: The Easy Way Out
films.plot: Ted returns to his hometown to find his big brother Jim at the end of his rope. But is it too late to save him?

films.title: Baa: Ek Yoddha
films.plot: The silent struggles, scarifies, and unconditional love of a father.

films.title: The Painting & The Statue
films.plot: Two lonely strangers meet across a crowded room. It just takes one held look, one breathless moment, to bring them completely alive...literally.

films.title: Children of The Wicker Man
films.plot: Fifty years after The Wicker Man, director Robin Hardy’s lost papers resurface, prompting his sons Justin and Dominic to explore the legacy of the cult classic, and their father. Together, they uncover the truth behind Robin’s role in the film and confront the complexities of independent filmmaking, family, and myth.

films.title: These Violent Delights
films.plot: Juliet awakens from a fever dream. How did we get here? The lines between hallucination and memory blur as cinema and dance collide in a kaleidoscopic journey of queer belonging, defiance, and self-discovery. A vivid retelling of Shakespeare’s Romeo and Juliet brought to life by Scottish Ballet.

films.title: Learners
films.plot: When a cantankerous widower reluctantly agrees to teach his son's unemployed girlfriend to drive, an unlikely friendship is sparked.

films.title: Celeste & the Cyan Sun
films.plot: On her last day in Italy, a young woman finds herself swept away by a new intimate friendship towards reckless abandon and tragic circumstances.

films.title: The Acres
films.plot: Christine enters The Acres estate with gardening tools and a plan, but then she encounters Ama, a lonely new mother. Ama reminds Christine of the early days of motherhood, a simpler time before things took a turn.

films.title: Ghostwatch: The Night That Terrified Britain
films.plot: Taking a look back at the 1992 BBC spoof supernatural documentary, when 11 million viewers were taken in by a fake investigation, presented by Michael Parkinson and Sarah Greene, into paranormal activity at a family home in Northolt, North-West London

films.title: ELECTRICKS
films.plot: An electrician takes a job to replace sockets, desperate for cash after months of unpaid invoices. In a young mother’s flat, he discovers an illegal electricity bypass left behind by her parents. For her, it means a debt of hundreds of thousands; for him, the impossibility of finishing his work. Should he walk away and look for money elsewhere, or help her through unofficial means? A drama about survival in a system that leaves both characters with no choice but to bend its rules.

films.title: See You Tomorrow Tomorrow Tomorrow
films.plot: An aspiring, queer stand-up comedian grapples with her career and the greater duty of caring for her 99-year-old grandmother in her final years.

films.title: Time's Up, I'm Afraid
films.plot: A hypnotherapist discovers she may be the one who has been hypnotised.

films.title: The Static
films.plot: A disturbed teenager finds herself questioning reality.

films.title: This House Has Roots
films.plot: A man tells the story of himself and the mansion home he lives in.

films.title: FLORID
films.plot: Jamal, a young man who hears voices, struggles to balance his medication with his musical ambitions and romantic desires.

films.title: ANON
films.plot: A brief encounter between a closeted taxi driver and a young male passenger leads to a frightening exchange with life-altering consequences.

films.title: Outsiders
films.plot: Davey's Chambers life is forever altered when an alien invasion forces him to survive with strangers inside of his compact flat.

films.title: Holly
films.plot: At a pivotal moment in her young life, eleven-year-old Claire grapples with the confusion of puberty and a strained relationship with her mother, until her father helps her confront the changes she fears most.

films.title: Behind the Reflection
films.plot: A woman struggles with their identity, leading to a life of addiction, alcoholism and violence. A gritty drama based on the true life of Rozelle Gemma.

films.title: Peter
films.plot: A trans man caring for his father with alcohol-induced dementia finds unexpected reconnection when the disease grants him temporary anonymity.

films.title: Breezeblock
films.plot: In the heart of the forest, a man is building a concrete wall to protect himself from a fly that is swooping down towards him.

films.title: The Neighbourhood is Changing
films.plot: Documentary on the making and legacy of Mulberry Street featuring new interviews with cast and crew

films.title: Marriage Test
films.plot: In a mosque waiting room in 1980s South Wales, a young Welsh woman and her Iranian fiancé prepare for an Islamic conversion ceremony that will test the strength of their love and their resolve.

films.title: City of Masks
films.plot: Ambition, obsession, and lost love collide in a haunted West End theatre where a disfigured composer, a rising star, and a jealous rival fight for control of a mysterious musical-and the masked legacy that threatens to destroy them all.

films.title: Rooted Out: Chapter One
films.plot: Set against the backdrop of the Southport Riots of 2024, a dispute between neighbouring families over a tree spirals into a volatile confrontation, exposing buried prejudice, racial tension, and moral hypocrisy.

films.title: The Fall
films.plot: In the early 18th century, in the Blue Mountains of Jamaica, enslaved Africans who had escaped from plantations founded autonomous communities of Maroons. Queen Nanny, their supreme leader, led their struggle for freedom.

films.title: HYBE CHEERING PARTY
films.plot: The heat of cheering for HYBE artists unfolds in cinemas! Sing along with your favorite HYBE Artists in 3D! A one-of-a-kind game-like cheering screening is coming, where fans can chant fan cheers and wave their light sticks while watching the music videos of BTS, SEVENTEEN, TOMORROW X TOGETHER, ENHYPEN, LE SSERAFIM, &TEAM, BOYNEXTDOOR, TWS, ILLIT, KATSEYE, aoen, CORTIS, and SANTOS BRAVOS on the big screen. Join this unforgettable celebration filled with diverse music, passionate fan energy, and a dazzling wave of Light Sticks!

films.title: Deuce Purgatory
films.plot: When the players of a mixed doubles tennis match get stuck at 40-40 for seemingly an eternity, underdog Shelly Shlop realizes that to win the match, she must find her self-worth.

films.title: Finding Faith
films.plot: A short film contextualising the cultural significance of George Michael's Faith album via unheard interview voice-over, unseen images by Herb Ritts, and behind-the-scenes footage of the Faith music video.

films.title: In the Shadows
films.plot: Tells the true story of Ramla Ali, who fled Somalia with her family as a young girl, seeking asylum in London from the civil war. As a teenager, she pursued her love of boxing, but did so secretly as she knew her family would disapprove. Ali became the first boxer, male or female, to represent Somalia at the 2020 Olympic Games and made history after winning the first ever professional female boxing match in Saudi Arabia.

films.title: Blind Man's Bluff
films.plot: Home alone while their parents are out, four cousins play "gato mia" (blind man's bluff). Their fun ends when two of the kids get into a heated argument, which escalates to sinister circumstances.

films.title: Lesbian Lines
films.plot: In a silenced Ireland, a community of lesbians builds an underground network of helplines - offering connection, survival, and defiance through the simple act of answering the phone.

films.title: The Pen That Will Not Bow
films.plot: The early life of Voltaire, before he became one of Europe's most influential writers and philosophers.

films.title: Black Hollow
films.plot: Set in the rural Midwest during the 1970s, Black Hollow follows Jessica, an innocent young girl sheltered by small-town faith and her worldly friend Helen, whose rebellious streak leads them both into danger. When the two sneak out one foggy night, they wander to a forgotten churchyard, an isolated place where sacred ground conceals something unholy. As darkness descends, Jessica's search for belonging turns to horror, forcing her to confront the evil that thrives beneath the surface of the American heartland.

films.title: Body to Heart
films.plot: In the picturesque village of Mazan in Southern France, known for the Gisèle Pélicot rape case, three women embark on a journey to heal from domestic and sexual violence by doing horse therapy sessions.

films.title: Aunty Ji
films.plot: On her daughter’s birthday, Kulsoom finally leaves her flat. Cut off from the world, a series of simple errands spirals into an everyday odyssey that shakes her as she struggles to find her way home.

films.title: Cornfield
films.plot: A creative child with a passion for drawing escapes the confines of a rigid school system through her imagination, where epic battle between mice and a hawk mirrors her fight for self-expression - changing both her world and her teacher's.

films.title: Control Line
films.plot: A determined Black woman in her mid-30s navigates the emotional and physical challenges of conception, loss, and motherhood, all within the intimate confines of her bathroom.

films.title: Agbara Nla: The Return
films.plot: When a feared village doctor rises with dark spiritual power to terrorize the land, a young courageous couple, Olatomi and Olaboye, must embrace their divine calling to confront evil, ignite revival, and prove that no power is greater than the name of Jesus.

films.title: Lobsters
films.plot: Surrounded by his best friends for a bachelor party at the family vacation home, Sami runs into a childhood friend who accuses him of abusing her a few years earlier. Throughout the weekend, Sami navigates his own conscience, sometimes misguided, sometimes pushed around by his friends. To recognize the truth, he will have to break through and abandon his shell.

films.title: Power Trip
films.plot: A rideshare driver ends up in an unexpectedly complicated conversation with a passenger.

films.title: Back in Business
films.plot: A scheming wife gets more than she bargains for when she persuades two happily retired assassins to help her escape the confines of a loveless marriage.

films.title: Do You See What I See? Cinéma Fantastique Then and Now
films.plot: Exploring France's rich history of fantasy cinema, this film details the genre from it's foundation to the present.

films.title: Aberfan: The Village That Fought Back
films.plot: Aberfan's grieving community takes on the government, demanding justice and removal of the remaining tips after the disaster that killed 144 people

films.title: Noise & Neighbours
films.plot: If you ignore the music, Liza Ludick’s new short film, Noise & Neighbours, can be classified as a silent movie. Still, with striking animation and the moving piano notes of composer Wesley West, the silence in this movie is significantly meaningful.  Veteran actor Tobie Cronjé and newcomer Olwethu Kuene play the roles of Helmut and Bolelo, two neighbours who can’t stand each other, but who, through the universal language of music, assume unique roles in fulfilling each other’s lives.

films.title: Blue Hour
films.plot: Joey, a student from Yorkshire, keeps his head down and works quietly, more comfortable with tools than with people. The workshop is familiar to him - noisy, practical, predictable. That changes when Skyla, an exchange student from Texas, joins the course. She's open, direct, and out of place in a way that immediately stands out.

films.title: Fish the Moon
films.plot: Follows a writer who begins getting calls from a government appointed censor who is tasked with monitoring his online output for ‘public security purposes’ and has a front row seat to his every move. Within that space—where things are created, consumed, edited and debated—a strange and unlikely connection occurs.

films.title: Rusalki
films.plot: A girl wakes up by a lake with a collection of women and no memory of how she got there. As fragments from her past resurface and memories come flooding back, tensions rise between the women and the girl tries to find a way to escape…

films.title: Red Ledger
films.plot: Captain Georgina Lee captures and interrogates Ellis's handler on why she was sent to disarm weapons. But a piece of Lee's history is brought up that she can't escape.

films.title: The World Came Flooding In
films.plot: The World Came Flooding In is an immersive VR documentary reconstructing memories of the eastern Australia floods in 2022, which is representative of similar events that happened recently in various parts of the world.

films.title: Selflove
films.plot: A young man finally finds his soulmate: himself. After all, no one understands him as well. The two of them could live forever in their comfort zone -- if only it weren't for that one little thing.

films.title: A Hair's Breadth
films.plot: Beck’s new moustache makes waves when it slows him down in the pool shortly before a big race. As his coach grows more aggressive in his attempts to make him shave, Beck must choose between his moustache and freedom, or his coach and treading water.

films.title: Hot Flash
films.plot: Geri, a skint Yorkshire mum in peri-menopausal chaos, goes viral after a wine-fuelled rant about her menopause app idea. Betrayed by friends and terrified of public speaking, she must conquer her fears, pitch big, and finally back herself.

films.title: One Last Day In The UK
films.plot: On her 28th birthday, Kyle is determined to enjoy a special day with Kieran, her partner of four years. As they move through London together, Kieran fills their day with thoughtful surprises, affection and moments that remind Kyle of why she fell in love with him. But beneath the celebrations, something feels wrong. Kieran is distracted, unusually emotional and increasingly desperate to make the day perfect, while Kyle struggles with the familiar loneliness she has felt within their relationship. As the day unfolds, the couple find themselves caught between the love they still share and the difficult realities neither of them has been willing to confront. What begins as a celebration of their life together gradually becomes an emotionally charged reckoning with what their future might look like. One Last Day in the UK is an intimate Black queer romantic drama about love, loneliness, sacrifice and the painful moment when loving someone may no longer be enough to stay together.

films.title: Hazard Perception
films.plot: An expectant father and a woman haunted by her fear of driving spark an unexpected connection while waiting to be called in for their driving test.

films.title: Close
films.plot: Keane, nearing thirty, finds a box of his absent father’s negatives. He prints the images in a darkroom’s red glow. As he and his mother Diane look through distant exposures from the half-past, the prints expose a life that was always out of frame. Closure leads them back to the shoreline, where Keane reframes what remains.

films.title: Wendehorn
films.plot: Tara is lead to a sacred forest after reading the Necronomicon. It it there that she is stalked by a creature that roams the woods and protects it's land and property.

films.title: Tony Spiteri
films.plot: A one-on-one game of basketball becomes a fragile confrontation between two men struggling to process loss.

films.title: Bwgan
films.plot: Six-year-old Betti isn't used to sharing her Mam, especially on her birthday. But when a baking disaster sends them into town for a new cake, an unwelcome gatecrasher turns a simple trip into an unexpectedly difficult adventure.

films.title: The Last Pancake
films.plot: A magical-realist drama about Amanda, who ventures to The Last Pancake cafe where she awakens her suppressed appetite, leading to an unexpected reunion with her nine-year-old-self.

films.title: Noise
films.plot: High from his rise to fame in an industry clamouring to promote him, a composer is privately challenged by his conductor. A film about how artists choose to defend their work, and where the blame falls if it all goes wrong.

films.title: Smooth Summer
films.plot: As Hanna and her ten-year-old niece, Erle, get ready for a day at the beach, Hanna is faced with a dilemma: How can she manage to be both a cool aunt and a good role model in this situation?

films.title: Contrition
films.plot: Based on a true story. Damien, a man in his 40s, is haunted by a traumatic childhood event—A violent IRA hostage situation he can't shake. After years of searching, he finally tracks down Brendan, one of the masked men responsible, who is now masquerading as a priest.  Driven by a mix of anger and a desperate need for closure, Damien arrives at Brendan's church, filled with unresolved pain. As the two confront their shared past, the tension escalates, revealing the complex web of guilt, remorse, and the possibility of forgiveness.

films.title: A Girl Called Alice
films.plot: In the middle of London's mobile phone theft epidemic; a young woman with the reputation of one of the most gifted phone thieves is challenged by a notorious street gang leader to see just how good she really is, but is it a wise choice?

films.title: Enter the Television
films.plot: From Tom Seymour creator of the VHS Massacre Trilogy. Enter the Television is a feature-length documentary exploring the dark corners of television from obscure commercials to unconventional cable programming. It examines the evolution of media through an underground lens, revealing how independent voices survive within systems controlled by powerful media corporations.

films.title: And What Do The Pigs Think?
films.plot: In a contemporary art museum, a zealous guard discovers that a taxidermied boar has fallen — in the span of a single sneeze. An investigation erupts.  Wild accusations, paranoia, and delusional theories turn the incident into a vortex of absurd and awkward chaos. A biting satire on collective fear, where only the taxidermied pigs keep their cool.

films.title: For Your Suffering
films.plot: A young boy lives in the shadow of his abusive stepfather - until tonight.

films.title: Sophie
films.plot: A young woman, isolated and recovering from a severe injury, finds herself battling a mysterious phenomenon as she’s hurtled towards a devastating realization.

films.title: Homecoming Shenanigans
films.plot: Ivan returns home after six years abroad in Barcelona, hoping for a joyful reunion with his vibrant family. However, what begins as a celebratory welcome quickly spirals into chaos as deep-seated secrets surface.

films.title: Alex Jones: One Day in Aberfan
films.plot: Alex Jones marks the 60th anniversary of the mining disaster that claimed 144 lives, including 116 children
films.original_title: Alex Jones: Un Diwrnod Yn Aberfan

films.title: Chuey
films.plot: Since moving from Malaysia to London in the 1970s, Malaysian-Chinese Buddhist and therapist Chuey has transformed the garden of her family home into a sanctuary of global flora; blending plants from across continents, her garden and personal story entwine in quiet narratives of migration, memory, and finding belonging. Set in the suburbs of North-West London as summer winds down, this meditative short invites us into her intimate reflections, offering a story of resilience, unity, and nature's power to dissolve barriers.

films.title: Escape Routes
films.plot: Adapted from a short story by Lucy Caldwell. In 1990s Belfast, a lonely young girl becomes entranced by her teenage babysitter, who introduces her to the computer game ‘Zork’ and a brief, bright world of secret codes, imagination, and escape.

films.title: The Voicenote
films.plot: A woman sends a voicenote to a friend she has been meaning to reach out to. As we follow the journey of the message, we see her friend descending into crisis. We can only hope that she gets the message before it's too late, be it this world or the next.

films.title: F**k Face
films.plot: During a casual game of Scattergories, four friends discover that the most dangerous thing in the room isn't time, guns, or bad language- it's how well they know each other.

films.title: Skyclimber: Scaling the Eiffel Tower
films.plot: Urban free climber Adam Lockwood attempts to scale the Eiffel Tower in a documentary that is equal parts high-altitude adventure and intimate personal portrait. A film that builds its tension with the precision of a heist movie, mapping every step of an audacious ascent.

films.title: Mask Murder
films.plot: Set 5 years before the events of Forest Floor. Discover the origin story of the masked man.

films.title: The Magic of It All: The Story of Strawbs
films.plot: A Cape Town recording session becomes the final chapter in the extraordinary story of British folk-rock legends Strawbs, as frontman David Cousins confronts illness and prepares for the band's farewell performance.

films.title: The Dog Whistle
films.plot: An obnoxious conservative politician is repeatedly pestered over the phone for an unknown reason

films.title: Beura
films.plot: The tale of the Cailleach Bheur, the Celtic goddess of nature, storms and winter, is well known to many in the Gàidhealtachd. Said to have carved the mountains and glens with ice, and borne the islands like children on her back, the Cailleach disappeared long ago leaving us only with her song – a sad, cautionary tale. This Gaelic arts project brings music, film and verse together to reimagine Cailleach’s story for the modern era.

films.title: MADE IN X
films.plot: Blending raw documentary realism with surreal, stylised dreamscapes, MADE IN X follows a young immigrant navigating life on the margins of a society that sees her as a label before a person. From workplace microaggressions to housing discrimination, her daily struggles are interwoven with poetic sequences where traditional garments, textures, and memories become tools of resistance and an escape. As fashion transforms into a language of identity and protest, the film explores how origin defines worth - not only for fashion items, but for people as well.

films.title: Hollow
films.plot: The young Lennart, a poor farmer, is out hunting with a friend when he stumbles and falls down in a hidden cave. And his life is forever altered.

films.title: Restoring Dracula
films.plot: This landmark 4K restoration from original film elements reinstates footage that was believed missing for more than six decades and was previously seen only by audiences attending the film’s original Japanese theatrical release in 1958. The recovered material has never been released before in the UK. It’s the cut the censors tried to bury.

films.title: Goddess Of Wealth
films.plot: Set in a small town in India during the festival of Diwali, Dhan Ki Devi follows a day in the life of a child influencer, Ayesha, whose parents have unintentionally traded her innocence in pursuit of social media fame. Using Goddess Lakshmi as a metaphor, the film critiques the commodification of children and the silent loss of childhood in the age of likes and shares.

films.title: Fox
films.plot: An off-hand confession about ‘helping a fox’ turns a tipsy date night into a claustrophobic reckoning of mercy, reason, and the terrifying impossibility of knowing another person.

films.title: Backflip Crazy
films.plot: A comic book artist sets off on a research assignment with a martial arts master while her insecure boyfriend stomps around with jealousy and fragile masculinity. Things take a turn when he challenges the Sensei to perform a backflip. Things get a lil' backflip crazy...

films.title: Let Me Go
films.plot: Following a death in the family Anna must confront her past in order to carve her future

films.title: Kitty
films.plot: Neurodivergent Kitty, lover of trinkets and Kate Bush, finds her favourite jumper ruined and must find a replacement. When the perfect jumper seems unattainable, she’s left with one choice: sell her precious collections, or risk losing the jumper forever.

films.title: Bermuda Riots Are Different
films.plot: An examination of a decade of race riots between 1968 and 1977, alongside a triangle of colonial influences: Bermuda, Great Britain, and the USA.

films.title: A Town Called Needville
films.plot: Told through 35mm photographs and first-person narration, A TOWN CALLED NEEDVILLE traces the filmmaker's four-month inpatient stay at an all-women’s mental health facility in Needville, Texas.

films.title: Betty
films.plot: A short film about Betty - a reclusive woman in love with a dead body

films.title: INTERTIDAL
films.plot: After encountering something otherworldly during a midnight swim, a woman is confined to a forensic tent on a remote Cornish beach where a government agent offers her coffee, reassurance - and a version of events that doesn’t match her own.

films.title: Call Lone Magpie
films.plot: By 2035, the US legalized the commercial hiring of hitmen to combat the soaring crime rates. And amongst them, "Lone Magpie" is considered one of the best in his profession. But throughout the making of his over-the-top commercial, the bravado facade begins to slip, as a morally-conflicted Magpie seeks answers from the director of the advert.

films.title: SEVENTEEN WORLD TOUR 'NEW_'
films.plot: Celebrating their 10th debut anniversary, SEVENTEEN embarks on a world tour fueled by their determination for a fresh start, just like the title 'NEW_'. With their unrivaled stage presence and explosive energy, SEVENTEEN once again proves their unlimited potential. Experience the blazing heat of the concert—bursting with each member’s unique charm—right on the big screen!

films.title: Dayshift
films.plot: While cleaning a pole dance studio, a middle-aged woman drifts from routine into reverie.

films.title: every pixels loving memory
films.plot: A partial autobiography of my body in its existence on and off screen. My body as an image alienated, pixelated, detached and repurposed from its skin and blood.

films.title: Take Care Of Me
films.plot: A woman finally receives her immigration approval to join her husband abroad, but her dog’s severe respiratory condition makes it impossible for him to travel. Caught between leaving her loyal companion behind or giving up the life she has long awaited, she faces a painful and deeply human choice.

films.title: Duckweed
films.plot: Obscure, aging, and living on the outskirts of London, writer of supernatural fiction Quentin Crisp asks himself a fundamental existential question: ‘Who am I?' This feature-length film-essay is structured around readings of Crisp’s own zuihitsu of the same name, which, in essence, is the story of his life. As we follow Crisp on a walk deeper into the ‘‘little wood’’ of his private landscape, the binaries of success and failure begin to fade away.

films.title: Ukraine Ghost Ship
films.plot: When Russian forces bombed a giant hydroelectric dam on Ukraine’s mighty Dnipro River in June 2023, farmland flooded, homes were destroyed and over 50 people lost their lives. Upriver, as waters drained, ancient ships’ timbers were uncovered on the newly exposed beach. Now, a Ukrainian archaeologist Dmitro Kobaliaa has assembled an international team to recover these remains, to reveal the story of a vast Russian military flotilla sent to conquer land around the Black Sea coast. It’s a battle still raging today. As fighter jets shoot overhead, Dmitro’s discoveries reveal a history of Ukraine before Russian rule, a history the Russians are trying to destroy, but one Dmitro is desperate to preserve.

films.title: Sun Day
films.plot: The Sun is walking around at work when loads of horrible stuff happens and it freaks the Sun out a little bit too much
